facts.text: Main car park: Bacon Lane, Churt, Surrey GU10 2QB, open 8am to 9pm and usually full by 10am. £1.80 for an hour, £3.60 for two, £4.80 for up to four, £7 all day; RingGo (location 16258) or card only. £60.90 to open the gate if you are locked in.
Bathing is in a marked sandy beach area in front of the Ranger's Office and the main car park.
Toilets open from about 8am to 9pm, with the car park.
Swimming is allowed only at the Great Pond, within the marked areas.
